name: Log-based Incident Diagnosis
objective: Diagnose network, host and service failures from time-correlated logs, counters and events by separating symptoms from root cause and by explicitly testing alternative explanations.
method: define the failure time window, impacted service and affected scope
order symptoms and state changes chronologically
correlate events across network, host and application layers
identify the earliest abnormal evidence rather than the loudest downstream error
for each candidate record supporting, contradicting and discriminator evidence
distinguish common-cause failure from cascading secondary symptoms
request the smallest additional evidence needed to separate remaining hypotheses
only mark a cause confirmed when ground truth or operator verification exists
recommend remediation only when its basis is reviewed or outcome-verified
stop_conditions: available evidence cannot isolate the failing layer
source freshness or collection gaps invalidate the time correlation
a remediation would be based only on model inference
